table.name: matches
table.purpose: One row per completed singles match on the WTA (women's professional tennis) tour, ~2013–2017, with tournament context and winner/loser player attributes (age, hand, height, country, ranking, seed) captured at match time. Structure matches the Jeff Sackmann tennis dataset format.

best_of.name: match_format_best_of
best_of.description: Maximum number of sets in the match; always 3 in this data (women's tour standard best-of-3).

draw_size.name: draw_size
draw_size.description: Number of players in the tournament's main draw (powers of two: 4 to 128).

loser_age.name: loser_age_years
loser_age.description: Losing player's age in years (decimal, computed from birth date) at the time of the match.

loser_hand.name: loser_playing_hand
loser_hand.description: Losing player's dominant hand: R = right-handed, L = left-handed.

loser_ht.name: loser_height_cm
loser_ht.description: Losing player's height in centimeters (range 157–185, consistent with female players).

loser_id.name: loser_player_id
loser_id.description: Identifier of the losing player; references players.player_id (many-to-one).

loser_ioc.name: loser_country_code
loser_ioc.description: Losing player's country as a 3-letter IOC code (RUS, CZE, USA, ESP, GER, ...).

loser_name.name: loser_name
loser_name.description: Losing player's display name (e.g. Svetlana Kuznetsova, Angelique Kerber).

loser_rank.name: loser_wta_rank
loser_rank.description: Losing player's WTA singles ranking at the time of the match (1 = best).

loser_rank_points.name: loser_ranking_points
loser_rank_points.description: Losing player's WTA ranking points at the time of the match.

loser_seed.name: loser_seed
loser_seed.description: Tournament seed number of the losing player (1–32); unseeded players presumably have a null/0 represented here, though all sampled rows are seeded.

match_num.name: match_number
match_num.description: Sequential match number within the tournament (148–300); not unique across the table because it repeats per tournament. Not a primary key on its own.

minutes.name: match_duration_minutes
minutes.description: Match duration in minutes (0–199; 0 likely a walkover/retirement with no recorded time).

round.name: round
round.description: Round of the match: F = final, SF = semifinal, QF = quarterfinal, R16/R32/R64 = round of 16/32/64, RR = round robin (WTA Finals).

score.name: score
score.description: Match score in sets, e.g. '6-4 6-4' or '6-4 6-7(4) 6-1' with tiebreak points in parentheses.

surface.name: court_surface
surface.description: Court surface of the tournament: Hard, Clay, or Grass.

tourney_date.name: tournament_date
tourney_date.description: Tournament start date encoded as YYYYMMDD integer (e.g. 20160815 = 2016-08-15).

tourney_id.name: tournament_id
tourney_id.description: Tournament identifier, typically year plus a code (e.g. '2016-M024', '2017-1052'); format is inconsistent across years, so exact scheme is only partially clear.

tourney_level.name: tournament_tier
tourney_level.description: Tournament tier: G = Grand Slam, P = Premier, I = International, W = WTA Finals (standard WTA tier codes; consistent with draw sizes and names like Us Open/Wimbledon/Singapore).

tourney_name.name: tournament_name
tourney_name.description: Tournament name (Indian Wells, Us Open, Wimbledon, Rome, ...).

winner_age.name: winner_age_years
winner_age.description: Winning player's age in years (decimal) at the time of the match.

winner_hand.name: winner_playing_hand
winner_hand.description: Winning player's dominant hand: R = right-handed, L = left-handed.

winner_id.name: winner_player_id
winner_id.description: Identifier of the winning player; references players.player_id (many-to-one).

winner_ioc.name: winner_country_code
winner_ioc.description: Winning player's country as a 3-letter IOC code (USA, RUS, CZE, ROU, ...).

winner_name.name: winner_name
winner_name.description: Winning player's display name (e.g. Angelique Kerber, Simona Halep).

winner_rank.name: winner_wta_rank
winner_rank.description: Winning player's WTA singles ranking at the time of the match (1 = best).

winner_rank_points.name: winner_ranking_points
winner_rank_points.description: Winning player's WTA ranking points at the time of the match.

winner_seed.name: winner_seed
winner_seed.description: Tournament seed number of the winning player (1–30).

year.name: tournament_year
year.description: Year of the tournament (2013, 2016, 2017); matches the year prefix of tourney_date/tourney_id.

table.name: players
table.purpose: Registry of tennis players (likely from tennis match data such as Jeff Sackmann-style datasets), one row per player, with biographical attributes. Referenced by matches (winner_id/loser_id) and presumably rankings.

birth_date.name: birth_date
birth_date.description: Player's date of birth as YYYYMMDD (stored as text/integer, e.g. 19970313 = 1997-03-13). Empty string means unknown. Some values like 19430430 are plausible; the format is consistent.

country_code.name: country_code
country_code.description: Three-letter country/nationality code (IOC-style), e.g. USA, ITA, ESP, GER, JPN. Includes historical codes like FRG (West Germany) and ECA, so it is the player's represented country, not necessarily current ISO.

first_name.name: first_name
first_name.description: Player's first (given) name(s); may include compound names like 'Katia Monserrat' or 'Maria Jose'.

hand.name: hand
hand.description: Playing hand: R = right-handed, L = left-handed, U = unknown/unspecified, empty string = missing. The dominance of U (69%) suggests handedness was mostly not recorded.

last_name.name: last_name
last_name.description: Player's last (family) name(s), may be compound like 'Delgado Valero' or 'Van Renterghem'.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Primary key uniquely identifying each player (20662 distinct values, range 200001-220672). Referenced by matches.winner_id and matches.loser_id.

table.name: rankings
table.purpose: Historical world rankings snapshots for tennis players (ATP/WTA-style): each row is a player's rank, ranking points, and tournaments played as of a weekly ranking date, from 1987 to 2017.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Identifier of the ranked player; references the players table (join not detected but values are player codes like 200009, 201305). Stored as text despite numeric-looking values.

ranking.name: ranking
ranking.description: The player's world ranking position on the ranking date; 1 = best. Ranges 1-1507.

ranking_date.name: ranking_date
ranking_date.description: Date of the ranking snapshot, encoded as YYYYMMDD integer (e.g. 20160307 = 2016-03-07). Spans 1987-01-19 to 2017-09-11, roughly weekly.

ranking_points.name: ranking_points
ranking_points.description: Ranking points accumulated by the player on that date (0 to 13615). Low values dominate because most ranked players have few points.

tours.name: tours
tours.description: Number of tournaments (tour events) counted toward the player's ranking on that date; 0-41.
